title: Wizards Play Network 2023: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Inspiration is found by looking outward." —Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter
Hand in hand, they sowed the seeds, and the battered earth began to flourish once again.
All through the winter Sam remained as patient as he could. Spring surpassed his wildest hopes.
Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.
